'''Iutuga''' was a large island on the planet of [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]]. It was located in the [[Ioliu Sea|Iuliu Sea]], east of the continent of [[Encheeko/Legends|Encheeko]].<ref name="planets">''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref> 
==Geography==
The island was covered with jungle and thick underbrush and there were few trails. In the center of the island was a grouping of hills containing several [[cave/Legends|caves]]. There were also several [[water/Legends|rivers]] flowing into the sea from the center of the island.<ref name="hunt" />
==History==
The island was uninhabited and typically it was used as a [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]] stage for candidates of the [[Goa-Ato/Legends|Goa-Ato]]. [[Airspeeder/Legends|Airspeeders]] brought candidates with their weapons of choice and basic survival gear, and the Guidl tracked their trial with [[Satellite/Legends|satellite]] or observers on airspeeder.<ref name="hunt">{{WEGCite|story=Jungle Hunt|book=Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide}}</ref>

One time, candidates were brought to the island with the task of capturing a [[RHTC-560 Hunter Trainer]] droid while fending off the ten [[RHTC-560 HT Drone]]s that protected it, within two [[standard day/Legends|days]]. However the [[Chattza clan/Legends|Chattza clan]] had secretly planted five of their own droids, specifically targetting non-Chattza candidates with blasters; due to a last minute change by the officials, the real droids finally had darker camouflage. The first day, an insisting rain caused the RHTC to retreat to the caverns, and drones were sent to harass the players and lead them away from the caves.<ref name="hunt" />
